title: Berlin Parking Zones - Quick Summary
items: **Berlin runs 103 managed parking zones across 8 of its 12 districts.** Lichtenberg, Marzahn-Hellersdorf, Reinickendorf and Treptow-Köpenick have none at all, so the kerb there is free and the pressure shows.
**The tariff is simple, the clock is not.** Zones charge 2, 3 or 4 euros an hour, but the charged week runs anywhere from 45 hours to 105. Nothing in the city charges before 09:00.
**Exactly one zone charges on a Sunday:** zone 29 in Mitte, covering Karl-Liebknecht-Straße, Torstraße and Rosenthaler Straße, at 4 euros an hour until midnight, seven days a week.

**The resident permit costs 20.40 euros for up to two years**, covers one vehicle in your own zone only, gives you no right to a space, and takes up to four weeks to arrive. At a 4 euro meter it pays for itself in 5 hours 6 minutes of parking.

**Two more Friedrichshain-Kreuzberg zones start soon:** Askanischer Platz on 1 October 2026 and Samariterviertel on 1 December 2026. Parking without a valid ticket costs 20 to 40 euros depending on how long you overstay.
